summary.text: Zaynab Mohamed is a Democratic state senator who represents District 63 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Diane Napper.
She was previously a community advocacy director with the Council on American-Islamic Relations of Minnesota.

paragraphs.text: Mohamed was born in Somalia and lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota. She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, and her career experience includes working as a community advocacy director with CAIR-MN.
Mohamed assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Patricia Torres Ray.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are Capital Investment, Finance, Housing and Homelessness Prevention, Human Services, and Jobs and Economic Growth Finance and Policy, where she is vice chair.
